root_idea.summary: The root centers on remaining, settling, and being established in a place.
root_idea.development: The tent is the concrete image of a settled dwelling, while related lexical branches extend to staying in a place, innate disposition, and cowardly stillness. These branches are kept distinct from the Quranic noun meaning.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular dictionary citation form خَيْمَةٌ; the supplied Quran occurrence is its plural خِيَام.

senses.definition: A tent, pavilion, or booth used as a dwelling or shelter.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural خِيَام, occurring in a description of pavilions. The lexical item covers tent-like structures whose materials and construction may vary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold back or refrain through cowardice or fear; to draw back from a war, encounter, conflict, or a devised stratagem.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I. The object may be a person or thing, and the withdrawal may be expressed with or without an accompanying preposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise a leg or foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I; a distinct physical use from the sense of cowardly withdrawal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pitch or fix a tent; hence to remain, stay, dwell, alight, or sojourn in a place; also, to enter a tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II. The same verb is used of a wild animal remaining in its covert and, tropically, of an odor remaining or clinging in a garment or place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something like a tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative construction, distinct from simply pitching or occupying a tent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cover something so that its odor clings to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical or assumed-tropical Form II construction involving the retention of an odor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a horse or other creature to stand on three legs, raising one leg; more generally, to be unable to place one leg or foot firmly on the ground because of a defect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV, in the construction إِخَامَةُ الفَرَسِ and related descriptions of impaired weight-bearing.
Form IV; a causative tent-building use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pitch or establish one's tent at a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V, normally construed with a place expression.

Applied to untanned or lightly tanned hides, unwashed or unbleached cloth, unprocessed goods, and date honey untouched by fire. It is also applied to paper, although the supplied wording is uncertain as to whether the paper is polished or unpolished.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Natural or innate disposition, temperament, or character; especially the original condition of the soul, including generosity or liberality of disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective or defective plural-like form with no ordinary singular of its own in the cited explanation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The diversified wavy marks, streaks, or grain seen in a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical descriptive use for the patterned surface of a sword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant of the ḥamḍ kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The identification is reported tentatively in the supplied lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fresh, juicy young growth of grain or other seed-produce; an ear, shoot, or fresh bunch or plant thereof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of growth appearing on a single stalk and of its fresh or juicy form; the plural is خَامَاتٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An extended or figurative application of a tent: a place of abode, a woman's howdah likened to a tent, or a divine tabernacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are extensions, comparisons, or assumed-tropical applications of the tent sense, rather than additional Quranic senses of the supplied occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A preparer of hides of the kind called خَامٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A professional designation derived from the raw-hide sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who applies himself to making tents or booths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun associated with خَيْمَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collection of bundles or handfuls of reaped seed-produce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal formation referring to gathered bundles of harvested grain or similar produce.

cautions: The Quranic form is attested once, as the plural خِيَام, and no root-specific Mufradat entry was supplied.
The entry for خَامٌ is explicitly described as an Arabicized Persian word in the lexical evidence; it is retained as a directly attached Classical entry but is not treated as a Quranic meaning.
The paper sub-sense under خَامٌ is textually uncertain, and the plant identification under خِيمٌ is reported tentatively.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The exact condition intended by the خَامٌ paper sub-sense is unresolved: the supplied text gives “polished” while suggesting that “not polished” may be the intended reading.
